title: shorea trapezifolia
intro: Shorea trapezifolia, commonly known as the Forest Oak, is a species of plant in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Shorea trapezifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues.
